title: New Year's Eve fondue (brown Meltie mug, glitter desk) — NYE 09
notes: New Year's Eve restage 09 of the "I love this mug!!" Short (shorts/uMl76XX7epo): BROWN variant of the real Meltie Mini Fondue Mug (store photos), on the white desk sprinkled with gold glitter (a white desk on New Year's Eve sprinkled with gold glitter, a shimmering gold sequin wall backdrop and gold star balloons behind). New Year's Eve decor instead of pumpkins; reworded NYE hook. The pour and the last dip spill on purpose.
